subject: Information Theory
title: Embeddings and Meaning Space
description: A fast breakdown of Embeddings and Meaning Space for builders.

hook.text: King minus man plus woman equals queen. A computer learned this relationship from raw text alone.

buildup.text: Word embeddings map words to vectors in a high-dimensional space where distance reflects semantic similarity.

discovery.text: Word2Vec showed that vector arithmetic captures meaning relationships. Similar words cluster together.

twist.text: Cross-lingual embeddings align different languages into a shared space. 'Cat' and 'gato' become neighbors.

climax.text: Embeddings compress language into a continuous code—the information-theoretic dual of discrete symbols.

punchline.text: Words as coordinates. Meaning as geometry.

quiz.question: What do word embeddings represent?
options: Words as vectors where distance reflects meaning similarity
